Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded “Ekam - Son Of Soil was released first,” relying on IMDb’s DVD/TV dates for Farber’s Nerve (2011) and ignoring evidence that Farber’s Nerve is a 2006 short (as indicated by the search results and Wikipedia, and even the IMDb page title “Short 2006”). The Planner failed to corroborate with Wikipedia as instructed and treated home media dates as the earliest release, leading to an incorrect comparison.
